fixed_recipe: tree-regularized consensus + six label-free slate count/diversity corrections + broad/conditional content graph smoothing + temporal slate corrections + three Bayesian-smoothed training-only cross-conditional priors + temporal batch-slate tree/repeat ordinal consensus + two confidence gates + active-day/slate-size expert routing + two training-coverage expert gates + training-only user-neighbor collaborative correction
selection_evidence: The final user-neighbor correction was selected from a temporally screened family. An April 8-18 exposure graph ranked April 19-21 candidates from other users' prior outcomes; the frozen 60-neighbor, squared-similarity, smoothing-8 candidate then selected weight 0.002 on every one of four disjoint validation-user folds. Its held-out primary gains were [0.00003803, 0.00001961, 0.00002128, 0.00001639]. The final recipe reproduces 0.61280465 primary with both GAUC and nDCG@5 above the 0.61278081 prior champion.
leakage_note: The content/temporal correction is transductive but label-free: it uses the complete supplied evaluation impression slate and static video metadata, matching the official batch evaluator. Outcome priors, coverage membership, and the user-neighbor graph use only the April 8-21 training block; the validation slate contributes identifiers but no outcomes. The neighbor graph uses training exposure overlap for similarity and other users' training outcomes for candidate estimates. The batch-slate tree is trained out of time on April 14-19, early-stopped on April 20-21, then refit before April 22-28 inference. No validation long_view, click, play time, or other outcome is read as a feature. Deployments that do not know the complete candidate slate must not use the transductive terms as written.
rejected_ablations: A temporally selected centered-outcome co-exposure item graph reached 0.58079550 raw standalone and 0.58118916 after within-user ranking, but all four residual folds selected zero weight; retained DCN and AutoInt artifacts also selected zero, while numeric-bilinear interactions regressed at the mean fixed weight.

Published KuaiRand CWM likelihood reached 0.56198001 alone; a 0.1 BCE-anchored variant reached 0.60583085 but retained two negative residual folds, and duration-threshold inference did not stabilize it.
A two-layer rich-categorical xDeepFM compressed interaction network reached 0.60725051 standalone but all four residual folds selected zero weight after 0.577833 CPU-hours of training.

Causal exposure-history Transformers reached 0.60735643 with session scope and 0.60686481 with 99.66%-coverage full-user scope; global and timestamp-gated residuals either selected zero weight or retained a negative held-out fold.

Multi-view user-neighbor profiles over item, author, music, tag-set, and type contexts reached 0.58122635 standalone but did not improve the champion stably; the best apparent OOF micro-gain regressed at its fixed weight.
Support-aware neighbor smoothing, gates, and beta-posterior LCB produced a best fixed residual of 0.61280525, but the +0.00000060 change included a negative user fold and was rejected.
Monte Carlo dropout LCB: fold correction signs disagreed and OOF primary regressed.
Continuous watch-ratio margin: widened cross-fitted primary regressed to 0.61106056.
Synthetic-exposure density weighting: square-root OOF primary was 0.611053 and full weighting was 0.6109525.
Video-type slate concentration: fixed score improved but cross-fitted primary regressed, so it was excluded.
Supervised weekly-slate CatBoost: 0.6047368 standalone and 0.6112029 cross-fitted in the ensemble after 0.811823 CPU-hours.
Exhaustive residual scan of 192 retained prediction artifacts: no candidate earned a nonzero weight on the four disjoint user folds at the tested coarse scale.
Cross-session GRU: 0.598792 standalone; additive OOF regressed to 0.6119788 and reranked fold weights disagreed.
Multi-token-tag history DeepFM: 0.607719 standalone; additive OOF regressed to 0.6120303 and fold weights disagreed.
Causal timestamp-gap proxy histories: the train-only proxy reached 0.755662 temporal-holdout AUC, but no derived state produced stable nonzero residual weights.
Continuous threshold-progress CatBoost: 0.587240 standalone, 0.6121895 additive OOF, 0.562779 CPU-hours, and 17.87 GB peak RAM.
Residual-initialized batch-slate tree: 0.592267 standalone and only 0.6122193 additive OOF.
Personalized content kNN: best validation primary 0.524039; rejected after training-only temporal selection.
Hierarchical personalized dense slopes: 0.600019 standalone, but the personalized component was only 0.510101 and additive OOF regressed to 0.6122667 with mixed-sign fold weights.
Cross-model confidence from 20 structurally diverse models: mean/median/vote/dispersion corrections produced no stable gain; the best OOF result was 0.6122835 with mixed-sign weights.
Temporally selected per-user expert gate: improved the April 20-21 probe from 0.5599496 to 0.5600790 and reached 0.6059629 standalone, but additive OOF regressed to 0.6122078.
Top-weighted pointwise batch-slate tree: improved its standalone score to 0.5921983, but additive OOF regressed to 0.6122713.

Contrastively separated long/short sequence encoder: temporal selection chose epoch 3, then the leak-free refit reached 0.6030859 standalone; additive OOF regressed to 0.6122197 and reranked fold signs disagreed.
Third-pass top-decile trimmed-consensus residual: aggregate fixed primary reached 0.6124525, but held-out folds 0 and 1 regressed, so the 0.0000215 apparent gain was rejected.
Repeated-video batch residual: fixed primary reached 0.6126777, but nDCG@5 fell and held-out fold 0 regressed after changing 3,699 pair orderings.
Session-count and size 11-20 residuals: both had mixed held-out fold effects after active-day routing and were rejected.
Third-history-quartile mean residual: fixed primary reached 0.61281383 and GAUC improved, but nDCG@5 fell to 0.54328007 and two held-out folds regressed.
Fourth-history-quartile median residual: both aggregate metrics improved, but one fold lost 0.00002295—more than the 0.00002098 aggregate primary gain.
Recent high-coverage watch residual: fixed primary reached 0.61279941, but one fold lost 0.00001168 relative to its 0.00001860 aggregate gain.
Training-aggregate transfer audit and a 205-artifact residual rescan found no stable new correction.
Random-log CatBoost transferred poorly (0.56101394 standard-log primary), while a nested 204-prior full random-panel search regressed to 0.61274505 OOF.
Public-validation pointwise/pairwise stackers, linear pairwise stackers, and a structural expert router all failed the user-disjoint acceptance test.
User-disjoint public-feedback rates selected zero weight in every fold.
Localized top-k reranking across 20 diverse experts regressed to 0.61234045 nested OOF primary.
Censored mixture-of-lognormals survival ranking reached 0.59077823 standalone and selected a nonzero residual in only one fold.
Kaplan-Meier-style threshold survival priors produced apparent fixed micro-gains but retained held-out regressions, including the 0.61282837 type-at-risk candidate.
Three-seed duration-regime experts reached 0.60820252 standalone and 0.61280549 fixed, but fold 1 regressed; coverage gating and independent regime biases did not stabilize the gain.
Whole-user residual CatBoost rankers reached 0.61187887 (PairLogitPairwise) and 0.61124790 (QuerySoftMax) standalone, but their cross-fitted corrections regressed and were excluded.
